name: Berthly
tagline: Run the marina, not the clipboard armada.
positioning: Berthly is the operating system for multi-site marinas — slip assignments, metered billing, and dockmaster chaos, finally in one place.

hero.h1: Your marina runs on sticky notes. That's adorable.
hero.sub: Berthly replaces the whiteboard, the tide-stained ledger, and the group text nobody reads. Real-time slip maps, metered utilities, and billing that actually reconciles.

features.title: Slip map that isn't a spreadsheet
features.description: Drag-and-drop every berth across every site. See occupancy, vessel LOA, and overstays at a glance — no more calling the dockhand to 'go look.'

features.title: Metered everything
features.description: Meter power, water, and fuel per vessel and bill it automatically. Stop eating the cost of the yacht running three AC units in July.

features.title: Reservations without the phone tag
features.description: Transient boaters book, pay deposits, and get gate codes online. Your dockmaster reclaims the four hours a day spent saying 'let me check.'

features.title: Compliance you can hand an auditor
features.description: Insurance certs, vessel registrations, and pump-out logs tracked with expiry alerts. Print the whole binder in one click when the harbormaster shows up.

features.title: Multi-marina, one login
features.description: Roll up 3 sites or 40. Standardized rate cards, cross-site reporting, and permissions that keep the intern out of the refund button.

features.title: An API that speaks marina
features.description: Push occupancy to your accounting stack, pull weather, sync gate hardware. Berthly plays nice with the systems you're stuck with.

testimonials.quote: We were reconciling fuel dock receipts by candlelight and prayer. Berthly metered it, billed it, and found $60K a year we'd been quietly gifting to boat owners.
testimonials.name: Marissa Vollmer

testimonials.quote: Onboarding eleven marinas onto one platform sounded like a threat. It took a season. Our dockmasters actually asked to keep it.
testimonials.name: Declan Ross

testimonials.quote: The overstay alerts alone paid for it. We stopped losing transient revenue to boats that 'forgot' to leave. Also the interface doesn't look like it was built in 2004.
testimonials.name: Priya Naidoo

pricing.blurb: For single-site marinas ready to retire the whiteboard.
For growing operators running multiple locations.
For enterprise marina groups and REIT-backed portfolios.

homepage.footerBlurb: Berthly runs the marinas that used to run on caffeine and guesswork. Slips, meters, and money — one calm tide chart.
